idea-plugin.name: Sout Boy
idea-plugin.description:
SoutBoy is an IntelliJ IDEA plugin for Java developers who are tired of typing System.out.println by hand every single time they need to debug something.

☢️ SoutBoy

Tired of typing System.out.println by hand every time you need to debug something? SoutBoy does it for you in one keystroke.

Place your cursor on any variable (or select an expression), press Ctrl+Alt+;, and SoutBoy instantly generates a formatted log with the class name, line number, and variable value — dropped right after the current statement, no matter how many lines it spans.

Roadmap

  • Kotlin support

Generated output

System.out.println("☢️ 42 ~ AuthService ~ token: " + token);

Features

  • Works with variables, expressions, and method calls
  • Detects the current class name and line number automatically
  • Smartly inserts after the full statement — even multiline chains like .sign(algorithm);
  • Inserts inside blocks like if, for, and while
  • Preserves indentation
  • Falls back gracefully when no variable is found

Built for developers who just want to see what's going on.
